name: head-roll-no-music
description: Device capture (~30 s, 2026-08-22): head rolls side to side, NO music playing — real stimulus for orientation-driven animations like rgbx-mask-eyes (cf. the synthetic head-roll scenario, which the capture-scenario notes flag as physically implausible). Despite silence, ~15% of frames are beat-flagged by the on-device DSP — real-world false-positive corpus for beat detection.
